notes: README.md has no commands; it links to development.md, backend/README.md and frontend/README.md, which agree on the flow. The .env (root) and frontend/.env are tracked with working local defaults (FASTAPI_ENV=development makes the 'changethis' secrets a warning, not an error), so no env step. prestart.sh also creates the first superuser (admin@example.com / changethis). uv workspace: pyproject.toml + uv.lock at the root with backend as member; .venv is at the repo root. bun workspaces (root package.json + bun.lock); `bun run dev` from root filters to frontend. Python >=3.14 (.python-version, backend requires-python); bun 1.3.12 is what CI pins (no engines). Alternative full stack in Docker: `docker compose run --rm backend bash scripts/prestart.sh` then `docker compose watch` (app on :8000).
